events.title: Viaplay Group Q3 2026 interim report January-September
events.text: On track to deliver full year targets, with continued execution of strategic transformation plan. Q3 Highlights * Group net sales up to SEK 5,251m (4,018), operating income up to SEK 122m (25) including ACI of SEK 0m (48) and IAC[2] of SEK -48m (33), net income improvement to SEK -30m (-142) with basic earnings per share of SEK ‐0.01 (-0.03) * Core operation net sales of SEK 5,251m (pro forma SEK 5,191m[1]) stable on an organic basis, and core operation EBITDA before ACI and IAC up to SEK 313m (pro forma SEK 276m[1]) * Group free cash flow of SEK -32m (-1,193), of which SEK 58m (-1,154) from Core operations and SEK -90m (-39) from Non-core operations * Allente Group integration on track with synergies as anticipated * Regulatory clearance received for sale of Dutch operations, with transaction expected to close in coming weeks * No change to 2026 financial targets or long-term Reported Core operation net sales amounted to SEK 4,014m for Q3 2025, and SEK 12,367m for nine months 2025. Reported Core operation EBITDA before ACI and IAC amounted to SEK -13m for Q3 2025, and SEK ‐54m for nine months 2025. Please see page 23 for more information regarding the pro forma financials. 2) Items affecting comparability in Q3 2026 mainly comprised restructuring and integration costs, as well as foreign exchange translation effects related to previous content provisions. Please see page 20 for more information regarding items affecting comparability. Alternative performance measures used in this report are explained and reconciled on pages 17-23. A word from our President & CEO The Q3 results demonstrate that we remain on track to deliver our full year targets, and that we continue to execute our strategic transformation plan and move towards our long-term objectives of healthy operating margins, restored cash flow generation, and lower borrowing levels.
